admission.scope: version-bound advisory text and explicit-image execution through the strict production parser

capabilities.read_scope: inline context and explicit admitted images

limitations: The twelve exact model records are policy-bound; only gpt-6.1-sol was exercised live. Native prefix/namespace alias lookup is broader and must be rejected by the wrapper.

Catalog defaults/visibility are frozen to the genuine bundled snapshot. Effective models must be explicit and report default_origin=pinned_native_catalog; no remote refresh or synthetic descriptor fallback.

Native apply_patch definitions may be present; acceptance concerns inaccessible mutation authority, supported by the read-only guard and direct native OS write-denial probe, not a claim that all write-tool definitions are absent.
Native read-only profiles permit reads beyond the workspace; shell/read tools are disabled, while server context and explicit image paths require their own admission.
Authentication success does not identify its credential store/account/token; requested model identity is not provider-reported actual model identity.

The earlier separate cancellation probe proved local active-group termination only. It was not repeated under the new catalog, and never guaranteed cancellation of already submitted remote work or reversal of usage.
Native internal inference calls/retries cannot be counted by this wrapper.

The corrected search probe emitted native search/open events but failed the strict parser and yielded no exported structured source URL. Search capability remains unverified/disabled; assistant prose/requested URLs are not accepted source evidence.
Historical v1/v2 admissions were invalidated for backend usability; their completed-turn observations alone did not establish parser success.
verified_observations: The exact current recipe, bundled catalog SHA and executable/version passed no-inference effective-config controls before model use.
The current native read-only sandbox read a synthetic sentinel and denied an actual write with EPERM/EACCES; forbidden file absent and content hashes unchanged.
The exact current recipe completed the controlled text probe with exit 0, zero native error items, unchanged content and a pass from the unmodified production parser.

The exact current recipe completed the explicit synthetic black-triangle image probe with exit 0, zero native error items, correct image classification, unchanged content and a pass from the same production parser.

The genuine bundled model snapshot preserves all IDs/order/default metadata/instructions and unknown fields; only tool_mode changed to direct, while code-mode host and every forbidden execution/delegation control remain disabled.
